# GTA 6 Countdown — Independent Grand Theft Auto VI Fan Guide

> GTA 6 Countdown is an unofficial, independently maintained fan guide to Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI / GTA 6). It is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Official announcements are the source of truth; distinguish confirmed facts from unannounced details.

## Guide pages
- [Home and release countdown](https://gta-sixx.com/): release date, platform quick answer, official video gallery, live timezone countdown and FAQs.
- [About GTA VI](https://gta-sixx.com/about/): concise facts about the game, release date, platforms, developer/publisher and setting.
- [GTA VI story](https://gta-sixx.com/story/): spoiler-light official premise featuring Jason Duval, Lucia Caminos and the Leonida conspiracy.
- [GTA VI characters](https://gta-sixx.com/characters/): Jason Duval, Lucia Caminos, Cal Hampton, Boobie Ike, Dre’Quan Priest, Real Dimez (Bae-Luxe and Roxy), Raul Bautista and Brian Heder.
- [GTA VI locations](https://gta-sixx.com/locations/): Leonida, Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Grassrivers and Mount Kalaga National Park.
- [GTA VI vehicles](https://gta-sixx.com/vehicles/): named vehicles and visible transport, with explicit notes that Rockstar has not published a complete vehicle roster.
- [GTA 6 release date history](https://gta-sixx.com/gta-6-release-date-history/): primary-source timeline from the original 2025 release window through the currently listed November 19, 2026 date.
- [GTA VI news](https://gta-sixx.com/news/): selected official announcements and video updates with Rockstar source links.
- [GTA 6 price and pre-order guide](https://gta-sixx.com/gta-6-price-pre-order/): announced US prices, official storefronts and regional availability notes.
- [Privacy Policy](https://gta-sixx.com/privacy-policy/): explains the current static site's contact, storage, third-party media and hosting behavior.

- [Contact GTASIXX](https://gta-sixx.com/contact/): contact details and correction submissions.

## Verified core facts (checked October 28, 2026)
- Full title: Grand Theft Auto VI; common names: GTA VI and GTA 6.
- Rockstar Games lists November 19, 2026 as the release date.
- Rockstar's December 2023 Trailer 1 announcement gave an initial 2025 window. Its May 2, 2025 announcement set May 26, 2026; its November 6, 2025 announcement moved the date to November 19, 2026.
- Announced platforms: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar has not announced a PC version.
- Rockstar describes GTA VI as a single-player experience.
- Setting: the fictional state of Leonida, including modern-day Vice City and destinations beyond the city.
- Central protagonists: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
- Official synopsis: after an easy score goes wrong, Jason and Lucia find themselves in a criminal conspiracy stretching across Leonida and must rely on each other.
- Rockstar currently names the ’95 Grotti Cheetah, ’55 Vapid Stanier Sedan, Ganado Retro Build, Shitzu Squalo and ’67 Vapid Dominator Buggy in edition-related content. This is not a complete vehicle list.
- The live countdown on this site targets midnight at the start of November 19 in each selected timezone. Rockstar has not published an exact global unlock time on this site.

## Editorial notes
- Use Rockstar Games as the primary source for release, platform, character, location, edition and vehicle claims.
- Edition-specific vehicles do not imply a full game roster or universal availability in every edition.
- Where the complete map, vehicle list, unlock time or PC version is not announced, say so plainly rather than filling the gap with rumor.
